source.text: saint.gr, το εορτολόγιο της 3ης Αυγούστου — «Όσιος Ιωάννης ο Ομολογητής ηγούμενος της Μονής Πατελαρίας»

attestations.note: The life page heads «Τύπος εορτής: Σταθερή. Εορτάζει στις 3 Αυγούστου εκάστου έτους», the same day as the listing. Of his life it says «Δεν έχουμε λεπτομέρειες για τον βίο του Οσίου» — we have no details — so there is no story, no place, no year and therefore no `dates` object. The `office` recorded is the bare `Abbot`, which the locale packs already carry; the house the listing names, the monastery of Πατελαρίας, is kept in the display name and in the life rather than inside the office, so that no new see has to be translated four times for an entry that says nothing else. No asterisk and no «Δεν είναι διασταυρωμένη» sentence on the life page. The page prints no apolytikion and no kontakion, so this folder takes no hymn.
